snippet.title: Foundation Update 1 - Quality of Life | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Now Available! Experience the latest Quality of Life Update, introducing a wide range of improvements, tools, and visual upgrades. 

🎮 Play Now on Steam and GOG!
Steam: https://bit.ly/Foundation_Steam
GOG: https://bit.ly/Foundation_GOG

✨ Main Feature Highlights ✨
🪚 Part Replacement: Swap out similar Monument parts while retaining their functions.
🛠️ Monument Editing: Move and edit entire Monuments with new selection tools.
🧱 Gate Snapping: Place gates seamlessly on Walls and Fences.
🗺️ New Visibility Layers: Toggle views like Housing occupancy, Patrol coverage, and Trader or Visitor tracking.
🛡️ Improved Patrols: More efficient Patrol coverage, clearer zoning, and improved safety feedback.
🧵 Full Outfit Overhaul: A full visual refresh featuring 130 brand-new outfits, 70 updated, and hundreds of matching portraits.
⛪ New Monument: Fulfil your villagers’ service needs with the new Modest Church, a serene addition to your city.
🏗️ New Building Parts and Visuals: Including - new third-tier density Housing shapes and visuals, new Windmill storage extensions, new Stone Bridge parts and new City Belfry visuals.
➕ And much more, including new animations, interface updates, and countless polish touches.

#FoundationGame #Medieval #CityBuilder #PCGaming #GameTrailers

For more news and information about Foundation:

Website: https://www.polymorph.games
